en.label: Elementary School
en.title: Colégio Salesiano Santa Teresinha
en.text: I began my education at the age of 3 in 2002 at Salesian School Santa Teresinha. My mother worked as a teaching assistant at the school, which made it possible for me to attend on a full scholarship. This excellent school played a pivotal role in my early development, imparting a variety of values and fundamental principles crucial for a child's growth.
